title: Capacity-Indexed Knapsack
statement:
Use capacity-indexed 0/1 knapsack DP to maximize total value at weight at most W. Each item can be taken once.

Input
n W, then n lines weight value.

Output
Print the maximum total value.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200, 0 ≤ W ≤ 100000. Weights are positive and at most 10⁹. Values lie in [1,10⁹].
